title: appstore-release config
description: Per-app App Store listing content. Credentials are NOT here — they come from the environment (ASC_KEY_ID, ASC_ISSUER_ID, ASC_P8_PATH or ASC_P8) and the numeric app id from ASC_APP_ID. Relative paths resolve against this file's directory.

bundleId.description: Reverse-DNS bundle identifier, as registered with Apple. Required by the credentials operation.

locale.description: The App Store locale this config's content is written in, e.g. en-US or tr.

locales.description: Additional App Store locales, keyed by locale code. Each entry overrides config.metadata for that locale; anything it omits is inherited. Omit this block entirely for a single-locale app.

metadata.description: The listing for config.locale, and the default for every entry in config.locales. Fields shared across locales belong here so they are written once.

primary.description: App Store category id, e.g. LIFESTYLE or PRODUCTIVITY.

ageRating.description: The age-rating declaration. Every key defaults to NONE or false, and the complete set is always sent — Apple returns 409 for a partial one. Omit this block for a 4+ app.

ageAssurance.description: Defaults to false. Required by Apple — sent as false when unset.

alcoholTobaccoOrDrugUseOrReferences.description: How much of this the app contains. Defaults to NONE. INFREQUENT_OR_MILD and FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE are the pre-2025 spellings, still accepted.

contests.description: How much of this the app contains. Defaults to NONE. INFREQUENT_OR_MILD and FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE are the pre-2025 spellings, still accepted.

gamblingSimulated.description: How much of this the app contains. Defaults to NONE. INFREQUENT_OR_MILD and FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE are the pre-2025 spellings, still accepted.

gunsOrOtherWeapons.description: How much of this the app contains. Defaults to NONE. INFREQUENT_OR_MILD and FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE are the pre-2025 spellings, still accepted.

horrorOrFearThemes.description: How much of this the app contains. Defaults to NONE. INFREQUENT_OR_MILD and FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE are the pre-2025 spellings, still accepted.

kidsAgeBand.description: Only for apps in the Kids category.

matureOrSuggestiveThemes.description: How much of this the app contains. Defaults to NONE. INFREQUENT_OR_MILD and FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE are the pre-2025 spellings, still accepted.

medicalOrTreatmentInformation.description: How much of this the app contains. Defaults to NONE. INFREQUENT_OR_MILD and FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE are the pre-2025 spellings, still accepted.

override.description: Raise the computed rating (sent as ageRatingOverrideV2). Omit to let Apple compute it.

profanityOrCrudeHumor.description: How much of this the app contains. Defaults to NONE. INFREQUENT_OR_MILD and FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE are the pre-2025 spellings, still accepted.

sexualContentGraphicAndNudity.description: How much of this the app contains. Defaults to NONE. INFREQUENT_OR_MILD and FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE are the pre-2025 spellings, still accepted.

sexualContentOrNudity.description: How much of this the app contains. Defaults to NONE. INFREQUENT_OR_MILD and FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE are the pre-2025 spellings, still accepted.

socialMedia.description: The app includes social media features. Required by Apple for new apps and updates since September 2026. Defaults to false.

socialMediaAgeRestricted.description: Those social media features are restricted by age. Defaults to false.

violenceCartoonOrFantasy.description: How much of this the app contains. Defaults to NONE. INFREQUENT_OR_MILD and FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE are the pre-2025 spellings, still accepted.

violenceRealistic.description: How much of this the app contains. Defaults to NONE. INFREQUENT_OR_MILD and FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE are the pre-2025 spellings, still accepted.

violenceRealisticProlongedGraphicOrSadis.description: How much of this the app contains. Defaults to NONE. INFREQUENT_OR_MILD and FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE are the pre-2025 spellings, still accepted.

ageRating4Plus.description: Deprecated: set `ageRating` instead. `false` still means 'leave the declaration alone'.

contentRights.description: Third-party content declaration, required before review.

price.description: Either the string "free", or an amount and the territory it is quoted in. Apple takes a price point rather than an amount, so the nearest one is used.

baseTerritory.description: Territory the amount is quoted in. Defaults to USA.

review.description: What App Review needs in order to reach a human and to sign in.

privacyPublished.description: Set to true once App Privacy is published in App Store Connect. Apple exposes no API to read it, so this is your word for it; until then `check` blocks submission.

releaseType.description: Deprecated: use the top-level `release` block. Still honoured, with a warning.

release.description: When and how an approved version reaches the store.

type.description: MANUAL waits for you to release it; AFTER_APPROVAL goes live as soon as Apple approves; SCHEDULED needs earliestDate.

earliestDate.description: ISO 8601 date-time. Required when type is SCHEDULED.

phased.description: Roll the update out to a percentage of users over seven days.

screenshots.description: Where the store screenshots live. Use `dir` alone for one device size, or `sets` for several. In either case a subdirectory named after a locale (./shots/tr/) overrides the base directory for that locale. PNG only, opaque (no alpha).

api.description: Which App Store Connect API uploads them. `auto` (default) uses the App Asset Library (API 4.5.1) when the app has one and falls back to the deprecated screenshot sets. iPhone Duo needs the asset library.

dir.description: Directory of exact-size PNGs, relative to this config file. Filename order is display order, and it must contain nothing but store screenshots.

displayType.description: The single device size, when `sets` is not used (legacy display type). APP_IPHONE_67 covers 6.7" and 6.9" (1320×2868, 1290×2796, 1260×2736) — there is no APP_IPHONE_69. Defaults to APP_IPHONE_67.

from.description: A folder exported by any screenshot tool, relative to this config. Every PNG under it is grouped by pixel size into device sets (iPhone 6.9", iPad 13", iPhone Duo…); a top-level folder named after a configured locale belongs to that locale. Use instead of `dir`/`sets`.

placementGroup.description: App Asset Library placement group for the single set, e.g. IPHONE_DYNAMIC_ISLAND_LARGE_PROFILE. Usually inferred from the PNG size; `appstore-release screenshots --list-groups` prints the current ones.

sets.description: One entry per device size. Required when the app supports iPad: Apple will not accept a tablet-capable build with no iPad screenshots. Add an iPhone Duo entry (placementGroup) for apps built with the iOS 27.1 SDK — required from April 2027.

displayType.description: Legacy display type. Omit when placementGroup is given.

dir.description: Directory for this device size. Defaults to screenshots.dir.

placementGroup.description: App Asset Library placement group. Required for groups with no legacy display type (iPhone Duo); otherwise inferred from the PNG size.

items.description: One device size: a displayType, a placementGroup, or both. With neither, the PNG size decides.

outputDir.description: Where the credentials operation writes the .p12, the provisioning profile and credentials.json. Git-ignore it: these are secrets.

subscription.description: Omit this whole block if the app has no subscription.

group.description: Reference name of its subscription group; created if missing. Defaults to the app's first group.

groupDisplayName.description: Customer-visible name of the subscription group.

groupLevel.description: Rank within the group; 1 is the highest tier.

introOffer.description: Introductory offer. A FREE_TRIAL has no price; paid offers are priced in priceTerritory.

periods.description: How many periods a PAY_AS_YOU_GO offer lasts.

localizations.description: Subscription texts for locales other than `locale`, keyed by locale code. Each entry overrides localeName / localeDescription / groupDisplayName for that locale and inherits what it omits.

name.description: Display name of the subscription in this locale.

groupName.description: The subscription group's display name in this locale.

name.description: Reference name. Needed only to create the subscription when it does not exist yet.

period.description: Billing period. Needed only to create the subscription.

priceAmount.description: Target price; the nearest Apple price point is used.

priceTerritory.description: Base territory for the price, e.g. USA. Defaults to USA.

productId.description: The subscription's product id, as created in App Store Connect.

reviewNote.description: Note for App Review about this product.

reviewScreenshot.description: Path to a paywall screenshot, relative to this config. Without it the subscription stays MISSING_METADATA.

promotionalOffers.description: Promotional offers for existing and lapsed subscribers, redeemed in the app with a signed offer. Created when missing; Apple does not allow changing one afterwards — create a new offerCode instead.

offerCode.description: The identifier the app passes to StoreKit. Unique per subscription.

name.description: Reference name, shown only in App Store Connect.

periods.description: How many periods a PAY_AS_YOU_GO offer lasts. Default 1.

priceAmount.description: Price in the plan's priceTerritory, for PAY_AS_YOU_GO and PAY_UP_FRONT. The nearest price point is used.

prices.description: Prices in further territories, e.g. { "USA": 1.99 }. Apple documents no equalization for offers, so a territory not listed here gets no offer.

territories.description: For a FREE_TRIAL: the territories it is offered in. Default: the plan's priceTerritory.

offerCodes.description: Offer codes: codes customers redeem in the App Store. Created when missing; their terms cannot change afterwards.

name.description: Reference name; also how this config finds the offer again.

periods.description: How many periods a PAY_AS_YOU_GO offer lasts. Default 1.

priceAmount.description: Price in the plan's priceTerritory, for PAY_AS_YOU_GO and PAY_UP_FRONT. The nearest price point is used.

prices.description: Prices in further territories, e.g. { "USA": 1.99 }. Apple documents no equalization for offers, so a territory not listed here gets no offer.

territories.description: For a FREE_TRIAL: the territories it is offered in. Default: the plan's priceTerritory.

eligibility.description: Who may redeem: new, existing or lapsed subscribers.

stackWithIntroOffer.description: true: a new subscriber gets the introductory offer too. Default false (the code replaces it).

autoRenew.description: Whether the subscription renews after the offer. Default: Apple's.

active.description: false deactivates the offer and its codes. Default true.

customCodes.description: Codes you choose, such as RAMADAN. Created when missing.

count.description: How many redemptions the code allows.

active.description: false deactivates this code. Default true.

oneTimeCodes.description: Batches of single-use codes, generated only by `appstore-release offer-codes` and written to a CSV file.

output.description: Where to write the codes (CSV), inside the repository. Keep it out of git.

easMetadata.description: Path to an Expo EAS Metadata store.config.json, relative to this file. Its listing, age rating, categories, release and review details are used; anything set in this file wins.

subscriptions.description: Several subscriptions — plans, tiers, groups. Each entry has the same shape as `subscription`. Use instead of `subscription`.

items.description: Omit this whole block if the app has no subscription.

group.description: Reference name of its subscription group; created if missing. Defaults to the app's first group.

groupDisplayName.description: Customer-visible name of the subscription group.

groupLevel.description: Rank within the group; 1 is the highest tier.

introOffer.description: Introductory offer. A FREE_TRIAL has no price; paid offers are priced in priceTerritory.

periods.description: How many periods a PAY_AS_YOU_GO offer lasts.

groupName.description: The subscription group's display name in this locale.

inAppPurchases.description: One-time in-app purchases, e.g. a lifetime unlock.

items.description: A one-time in-app purchase, created when missing.

name.description: Reference name. Needed only to create it.

localeName.description: Display name in the config's locale.

priceTerritory.description: Base territory for the price. Defaults to USA.

reviewScreenshot.description: Screenshot for App Review, relative to this config.

testflight.description: What `appstore-release testflight` does with the newest build: notes, groups, testers, beta review.

whatToTest.description: What to Test: one string for the config's locale, or an object keyed by locale.

groups.description: Beta groups to put the build in; created when missing. A string is an external group.

internal.description: Internal groups need App Store Connect users and no beta review.

description.description: Beta app description — required before external testing.

usesNonExemptEncryption.description: Export compliance answer, when the build does not carry ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption.

submitForReview.description: Send the build to beta app review when an external group has it. Defaults to true.

preflight.description: The offline check of the app itself (`appstore-release preflight`, and the App section of `check`).

ignore.description: Findings that do not apply to this app. Each stays in the report as information, with its reason, so the decision is on record.

id.description: A finding id, e.g. app.account-deletion; it also covers ids under it (app.permission.default-text covers every key).

reason.description: Why it does not apply. Required: a waiver without a reason is just a hidden warning.

accessibility.description: Accessibility Nutrition Labels: what the app supports, per device. A feature left out is not claimed. Written as a draft, and published when publish is true.

publish.description: Publish the declarations on the App Store. Default false (draft only).

url.description: A page that describes the app's accessibility (App Information → Accessibility URL).

listing.description: The textual listing for one App Store locale. Apple splits these across two resources; this tool routes each field to the right one.

name.description: App name as shown on the App Store.

description.description: Full description. No emoji — App Store Connect rejects them with 409 ATTRIBUTE.INVALID.INVALID_CHARACTERS. Bullets and em dashes are fine.

keywords.description: Comma-separated, up to 100 bytes in UTF-8 including the commas (ç, ş, ü count two; Japanese and Chinese three).

copyright.description: Required, even for a free app; without it App Store Connect refuses 'Add for Review'.

whatsNew.description: Release notes. ONLY for updates — setting it on a first version returns 409 STATE_ERROR.

listing.title: Localized listing
